listing.name: Urban Chaos (OpenChaos)
listing.summary: Research listing. Upstream route: Desktop native packages, owned-data setup and upstream end-to-end-play claim. Limits: Upstream says end-to-end playable; newer modernization with remaining bugs, not Portcove support. Upstream platforms: Windows x86-64 package; macOS Apple-Silicon ARM64 and Linux SteamDeck packages/builds documented. Linux selected artifact CPU not explicitly mapped in frozen release research. Original data: Newer modernization; retain raw upstream claim as unverified, not Portcove support status. Portcove setup/gameplay not verified.
